trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction continuation call: verify items were already completed in a prior touch, so the rep moves straight to scheduling and gets a date and time locked with minimal resistance. The one wrinkle — the customer's frustration at being called by five companies — is handled adequately but generically, and the button-up is thin (no 'is that fair' handshake, no explicit no-driving/computer instruction, no full recap of what to expect beyond a partial explanation prompted by the customer himself).
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; the transcript shows a clear day+time agreement (April 25, 10:00AM) confirmed by both sides, which meets the booked bar even though bill and interest-reason were never captured on this call.
